title: Battle of Nanjing (1853)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Nanjing (1853)", at revision 1370451284, opens: "The Battle of Nanjing (1853) began after the fall of Wuhan on March 8, 1853, and ended with the fall of the capital city of Nanjing on March 19, 1853, to Taiping troops, a few days after the Qing government evacuated the city." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4871859, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "battle of nankin 1853". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
